answers.core: It affects the core directly and cannot be done as an asset I think.
answers.workaround: I can put the gdnative libs outside the submodule and link them with absolute paths, but this kinda compromises the reason why I made a submodule. I want to have a "self-sustaining" submodule, which my team can just use as "plug and play".

title: Make GDNative work with relative paths, too
